title: Paid Precision Tune-Ups Booked as Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
A paid precision tune-up is sold as a maintenance request call under Repair and Emergency Service Calls on the following terms.

**Who books a paid tune-up.** A customer without an active Comfort Club agreement may book a paid precision tune-up as a maintenance request call. So may a member who has no visit left for that system and season. The call must be in a class where paid tune-ups are bookable. Whether the class allows it is read from the call's class and symptom on the call record.

**How it is billed.** It is billed as one tune-up line at the class's tune-up price per system, under the precision tune-up task. No diagnostic fee is charged.

**Members with a visit available.** A member with a visit available books the tune-up against the agreement instead and is not billed on the service call.

**Repairs found during the tune-up.** Repairs found during a paid tune-up are quoted and billed as repair tasks on the same call, with no diagnostic fee added.

**Documented maintenance.** A paid tune-up on a unit counts as documented maintenance for protection contract claims once the call's balance is paid.

## Decision table

| Customer | Visit left on the agreement for that system and season | Class allows paid tune-ups | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| No active Comfort Club agreement | — | Yes | Paid tune-up booked, one tune-up line per system, no diagnostic fee |
| Active member | None left | Yes | Paid tune-up booked on the same terms |
| Active member | A visit available | — | Booked against the agreement, not billed on the service call |
| Any | — | No | Not booked as a paid tune-up in that class |

## Example (hypothetical)

A non-member books a Weekend Service Call tune-up for two systems. The invoice carries the class's tune-up price for each system and no diagnostic fee. A capacitor replacement quoted during the visit and approved is billed on the same call as a repair task, again with no diagnostic fee.
